services.name: Custom Gunite Pool Construction
services.description: Hand-drawn designs, structural shotcrete, and hand-troweled interior finishes on every new-construction pool. Every Kingsley pool is drawn on paper before a single stake goes in the ground; no prefab shapes, no stock plans. Most projects run ten to fourteen weeks dig to first swim.

services.name: Spa Installation and Integration
services.description: Attached spas, raised spas, and standalone installations integrated with existing pool systems or new construction. All spas include jet configuration specified to household use — we don't sell stock jet packages. Conversion of older pool/spa combinations supported.

services.name: Pool Resurfacing and Refinishing
services.description: PebbleSheen, Diamond Brite, and traditional plaster resurfacing for residential pools ten years or older. Coping and tile repair included where needed. Most resurfacing projects complete in three to five days with minimal disruption to landscaping.

services.name: Equipment Upgrades and Automation
services.description: Variable-speed pump swaps, salt chlorination conversions, and Pentair IntelliCenter or Hayward OmniLogic automation installs. Labor and consultation are where we earn our fee — equipment costs pass through at actual pricing.

services.name: Ongoing Maintenance and Service
services.description: Weekly and bi-weekly service for Kingsley-built pools and select customer-requested accounts. Water chemistry, equipment inspection, and filter maintenance on fixed schedules. Not our primary trade — we maintain to preserve the build, not as a standalone offering.

serviceAreaRegion: Central Florida — Marion, Alachua, Lake, and Sumter counties.

testimonials.name: Patricia L.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Marcus drew three different pool shapes on my kitchen table before we settled on the one that actually fit the yard. Ten weeks later we were swimming in exactly what he drew. The travertine edge is hand-cut. The whole thing is hand-cut. You can't buy that kind of work at the chain builders.
testimonials.quoteShort: Marcus drew three different pool shapes on my kitchen table. Ten weeks later we were swimming in exactly what he drew. The whole thing is hand-cut.

testimonials.name: Daniel F.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: We interviewed four pool builders. Kingsley was the only one who asked about how we'd use the pool before pricing it. Three years in, still the best decision of the build.
testimonials.quoteShort: The only builder who asked about how we'd use the pool before pricing it. Three years in, still the best decision.

testimonials.name: Margaret H.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Resurface project. In and out in four days, water chemistry sorted, deck tile repaired. Invoice matched the quote to the dollar. Would use again without a second thought.
testimonials.quoteShort: Resurface in four days, chemistry sorted, deck tile repaired. Invoice matched the quote to the dollar.

testimonials.name: Robert T.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Custom spa addition integrated with our existing pool. Eleanor handled every change order with a phone call first, paper second. No surprise charges. Five stars from me and the wife.
testimonials.quoteShort: Custom spa integrated with existing pool. Every change order a phone call first, paper second. No surprises.

testimonials.name: Susan M.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Our pool is six years old now. Kingsley still handles the annual service checks. The pool looks like it did on first-fill day. Whatever they put in the shotcrete, it works.
testimonials.quoteShort: Six years old. Kingsley still handles the annual service checks. Looks like first-fill day.

testimonials.name: James D.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Hand-drawn design process felt old-fashioned going in. By week three of construction I understood why they work that way — every detail had been thought through before the concrete truck arrived.
testimonials.quoteShort: Hand-drawn design felt old-fashioned going in. By week three I understood why — every detail thought through.

testimonials.name: Angela W.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Equipment upgrade, not a build — variable-speed pump and salt system conversion. Marcus talked us out of two upgrades we didn't need and into one we wouldn't have thought to ask for.
testimonials.quoteShort: Equipment upgrade. Marcus talked us out of two we didn't need and into one we wouldn't have thought to ask for.

testimonials.name: Thomas R.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Custom 24-foot travertine deck around a new pool build. The finish cuts are clean enough that the pool contractor down the road tried to hire their mason.
testimonials.quoteShort: 24-foot travertine deck, finish cuts clean enough the pool contractor down the road tried to hire the mason.

testimonials.name: Linda K.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Project ran two weeks longer than estimated because of rain. Kingsley absorbed the schedule slip and stayed on price. Honest builders.
testimonials.quoteShort: Rain ran the project two weeks long. Kingsley absorbed the slip and stayed on price. Honest builders.

testimonials.name: Michael P.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: PebbleSheen resurface. They drained, prepped, and refinished the pool in a way that makes our ten-year-old pool look brand new. Marcus's crew treats every job like their own backyard.
testimonials.quoteShort: PebbleSheen resurface. Ten-year-old pool looks brand new. Crew treats every job like their own backyard.

testimonials.name: Jennifer A.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Asked three builders what they'd do with the weird corner of our lot. Two offered a rectangular pool we didn't want. Kingsley offered a free-form build that treated the corner as an asset.
testimonials.quoteShort: Two builders offered a rectangular pool we didn't want. Kingsley treated our weird corner as an asset.

testimonials.name: Steven B.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Pentair IntelliCenter retrofit on a ten-year-old pool. Marcus did the site walkthrough, spec'd the install, and had his guys in and out in one day. App works on the first try.
testimonials.quoteShort: IntelliCenter retrofit. Site walkthrough, in and out in one day. App works on the first try.
